method: Read all 20 cited source responses, inspected relevant original article content, independently queried official MLB/MiLB game logs for all seven return dates; artifacts in pass2-a/. Native iframe playback remains main agent evidence.

results.finding: Primary Mariners release explicitly starts Tacoma rehab August 12. Independent AAA game log confirms 2017-08-12 vs Reno. MLB return August 19 is a later milestone. Diagnosis all three components supported.

MLB return report says March 6 incident and first return against Pirates Monday March 20. Independent spring log confirms 2023-03-20. Facial lacerations/no fracture supported; exact stitch count wisely omitted because reports differ.
MLB report explicitly two weeks after May 17, entered left field seventh inning then batted eighth. Official log confirms May 31. No rehab and mask protection supported.
First rehab report explicitly first appearance Tuesday; independent AAA log dates it August 23, 2022. Surgery report Wednesday June 29. Left thumb distinct from concurrent right elbow UCL supported.
MLB report confirms June 16 left hand fracture and no surgery; August report explicitly no rehab assignment, changed to right field. Official log confirms August 12 return.

SI team-report supports jaw injury/stitches/no fractures. MLB September 16 article describes preceding night return; independent game log confirms September 15. No unsupported concussion-negative claim.
MLB explicitly fractured LEFT fifth metacarpal May 24, distinct from February RIGHT forearm. First rehab report Friday July 26 refers to Thursday; independent High-A log confirms July 25.
